title: Live proof: declared dotnet test runner after install and restart
outcome: Live proof: declared dotnet test runner after install and restart
acceptance: LIVE PROOF (aa219353), exactly one, after install and restart: a scratch git repository under this repo's `.tmp` with one xUnit v2 project, `termal-tests.toml`, and `.termal-results/` git-ignored. A root session names that root and runs the declared `dotnet test --logger "trx;LogFileName=results.trx" --results-directory .termal-results` in the pushd form: (a) passing → a credited check with the TRX counters on its record; (b) one failing test → FAIL published; (c) the command run without the logger flag (so not matching an entry) → not a check, and the declared command with the artifact deleted before resolve → UNKNOWN withheld with its reason.

completion.summary: Pre-pilot technical qualification (not a pilot) of the declared dotnet test runner on the restarted host built from f5a96582, which contains 2b1e3f85. The fixture is a clean, no-submodule xUnit v2 project in the TermAl worktree .tmp/wt-csharp-proof-11410, per the 04:02Z placement ruling, with untracked termal-tests.toml and .termal-results/ Git-ignored. Phoenix was untouched. All four witnesses ran in the Claude pushd one-call form, on naming generation 695: (a) PASS credited, 8056fce4, with TRX counters; (b) FAIL published, f355b6f3; (c) the command without --logger, no record, not a check; (d) the artifact deleted after VSTest, UNKNOWN withheld with its reason ("the artifact is missing at the end"). Independent evaluation 248ee795 (delegation-9ca31fe0): criterion 1 passed. Earlier generation-684 records 9d70cb10/91dd5682 were superseded after a re-naming on claim recovery voided their citation.
